boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct UC San Diego study environments, with access details drawn from current university study-space guidance.

cards.title: Geisel Library
cards.subtitle: Central campus library study floors
cards.notes: Start with the library’s broad mix of individual and group seating, then use the current-hours link before heading over; campus ID is required after midnight.
cards.short_summary: A large central-campus library option with both solo and collaborative study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Geisel Library as a 3,000-seat study location, open continuously from Sunday 10 a.m. through Friday 6 p.m. during academic quarters.
cards.access_notes: Academic-quarter hours listed as continuous Sunday 10 a.m.–Friday 6 p.m.; valid campus ID required after midnight. Hours can change during breaks and finals.

cards.title: WongAvery Library
cards.subtitle: Health-sciences library study space
cards.notes: Use this library when its shorter, posted operating window fits your schedule, and check the library-hours link before leaving because quarter and break schedules can shift.
cards.short_summary: A separate UC San Diego library with its own study seating and schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists WongAvery Library as a study location with 900 seats and publishes its academic-quarter hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed academic-quarter hours: Mon–Thu 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Fri 9 a.m.–5 p.m., Sun noon–8 p.m.; closed Saturdays. Verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Price Center Reservable Study Rooms 1–8
cards.subtitle: Price Center East, Level 1
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused small-group session; bring your UC San Diego ID and reservation confirmation, and plan around the two-hour per-day reservation limit.
cards.short_summary: Eight reservable rooms with a table, four chairs, and outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: University Centers states that Price Center East study rooms 1–8 have a table, four chairs, and outlets, and are limited to two hours once per day per user.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are limited to currently enrolled regular UC San Diego students, faculty, and staff with a UC San Diego email address; UC San Diego ID and confirmation are required at check-in.

cards.title: Open Desk
cards.subtitle: Price Center West, Level 2
cards.notes: Book an individual workstation or private office when you need a desk setup; from 11 p.m. to 2 a.m. Monday through Thursday, spaces become first come, first served.
cards.short_summary: A reservable work-and-study space with ergonomic furnishings and technology.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego describes Open Desk as a hoteling-style study and work space with individual workstations, a private office, Wi-Fi, sit/stand desks, and a monitor.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–2 a.m. (11 p.m.–2 a.m. no reservation needed, first come first served); Fri 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sat–Sun 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Reservations require T-RES access.

cards.title: Treehouse Computer Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center, Level 2
cards.notes: Set up above Campus Bike & Skate when a computer-lounge environment suits the task, then pair it with nearby Student Center study spaces if you need a change of pace.
cards.short_summary: A named computer lounge on the Student Center’s second level.
cards.evidence_claim: University Centers identifies the Treehouse Computer Lounge as a study-space option on level 2 of the Student Center, above Campus Bike & Skate.
cards.access_notes: Located in Student Center on level 2, above Campus Bike & Skate. Check University Centers for current building access and hours.

cards.title: Blue Pepper Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center study lounge
cards.notes: Choose a study carrel or another seat, plug in at an outlet, and use the varied seating when you want a lounge setting instead of a reservable room.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center lounge with carrels, outlets, and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: University Centers lists Blue Pepper Lounge among Student Center study spaces and specifies study carrels, outlets, varied seating, a fireplace, and restrooms.
cards.access_notes: A non-reservable Student Center study-space option; verify current Student Center access and hours with University Centers.

cards.title: RIMAC Annex 2nd Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: RIMAC Annex, second floor
cards.notes: Bring work that fits couch-style seating or a table, and consider the adjacent outdoor seats when conditions allow; check Recreation updates during holidays, breaks, or finals.
cards.short_summary: A lounge with indoor couches, tables, chairs, and additional outdoor seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists the RIMAC Annex second-floor lounge with 40-plus indoor spots, additional outdoor seating, couch-style seating, tables, and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Listed academic-quarter hours: Mon–Fri 6 a.m.–11 p.m. and Sat–Sun 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Hours may change during finals, holidays, breaks, and summer.

cards.title: Sankofa Hall Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Eighth College, Sankofa Hall
cards.notes: Use the commuter lounge for a daytime session with charging access, and plan around its stated daily closing time rather than assuming residence-hall lounge access.
cards.short_summary: An Eighth College commuter lounge with 33 seats and charging ports.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists the Sankofa Hall Commuter Lounge as a 33-seat study space with outlet charging ports.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Sunday, 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; closed holidays and breaks. This is distinct from resident-only Sankofa Hall lounges.

cards.title: Angela’s Space
cards.subtitle: Marshall College
cards.notes: Head here for an all-student study setting within Marshall College, and time your work before the published 11 p.m. closing rather than relying on residence-hall access.
cards.short_summary: A Marshall College study space open to all UC San Diego students.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Angela’s Space as a 50-seat Marshall College study location open to all students from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 8 a.m.–11 p.m. The university’s study-space page says college-space hours can change during finals, holidays, breaks, and summer.

cards.title: Barnwood
cards.subtitle: Galbraith Hall, Revelle College
cards.notes: Use Barnwood for a quiet-study session in Galbraith Hall, and check Revelle updates during schedule changes; its final-week schedule differs from its standard listed hours.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study space in Galbraith Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego identifies Barnwood in Galbraith Hall as a quiet study space with 82 seats and lists extended 24/7 access during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Listed standard hours: 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; 24/7 during finals week. University guidance notes that hours can change during finals, holidays, breaks, and summer.
